fichas.title: Canoe slalom courses
fichas.summary: Requirements for natural and artificial canoe-slalom courses are described. Natural courses use steep waterways or tailwaters, with or without obstacles. An artificial Olympic course is described at the Eiskanal/Lech near Augsburg; drawings show a slalom course, horizontal section, channel cross-section, and control trap.

fichas.title: Competitive rowing and canoeing regatta courses
fichas.summary: Track-marking diagrams show international dimensions for competitive rowing and canoeing, including a Munich regatta-course plan. The page indicates lane arrangements and course lengths for rowing and kayak/canoe events, and notes a favourable course direction of SW–NE.
